profile.headline: You are never given a wish without also being given the power to make it true.
profile.summary:
- Principal Engineer | Software Architect | Solutions Engineer

Throughout my career I have worked for great companies: Mentor Software Solutions, IBM, TATA Consultancy Services, USAA Army Bank [TCS], Bank of America [TCS], GoIT in Illinois [Deloitte], GoIT in Colorado [Deloitte], and SAIC. 

My goal and passion is to deliver high quality software solutions for production environments. My expertise is on the backend development. security, and DevOps.

| +20 years of experience |  English fluent | Spanish Native | Oracle Java Certified | Technology Enthusiast |

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer at CDHS / Governor's Office of Information Technology (GOIT) - Colorado.

Maintain and support production and low level environments for some of the government applications. Deploy code into the UAT / SIT / POC / PROD environments, Web Applications, SOA apps and DB injections.  Liferay [java]. Security. AD, EDirectory, LDAP transactions, Bindings.

Java batch jobs. Automate common tasks. Database reports. Email Automated Reports, [Apache POI]. Automate mechanical/recurring tasks.

--Responsibilities:

1-Applications/Servers monitoring 
2-Batch jobs / Task automation
3-Code deployments. (Java, JEE, SOA and SQL artifacts).
4-Application Development. 
5-Ticket tracking.
6-System monitoring.
7-Project Management. 
8-Tech leader. 

Technologies:  Java, Spring Boot, IntelliJ, Eclipse, SVN, GIT, JSON, JS, Cloud Solutions, Liferay, SSH, MySQL and LDAP.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java developer. Create batch jobs to process high volume information for the state of Illinois, Requiring strong OOP knowledge techniques,  Implemented higher level interfacing/adapters for the java framework Bridges in order to provide customized development efficiency. 

Responsible to create java applications that share/secure/transport sensitive/classified encrypted information. 

Tech: Java, DB2, SQL, DAO, Shell Script, JDBC, Crontab, SSL, TLS, Web Sockets.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
TATA Consultancy Services. TCS–Bank of America.
Java / Web Developer, from September 2010 – 2012
Project: Mobile Remote Deposits. (MRD).

Mobile Remote Deposits is a Bank of America initiative to allow their customers to deposit a check by taking a picture with a smartphone. 

Maintain and improve the existing application. Code development and new code releases on SIT and POC (Prove of concept) environments for QA. Create batch jobs to create admin reports about how many transactions were performed per day, money movements by time-range, failed  and reasons of failures for all the remote transactions processing. 

This is vital information for the LOB (line of business), the batch jobs collected the information from an Oracle Database in PRD, creating an Excel report by using Apache POI with all the necessary information delivering an intuitive excel file easy to read and understand. including formulas, procedures, tabs, and cell highlighting for those rare/special cases so they can be easily identified by the managers. 

Once the report is created they are automatically copied to a Microsoft Share Point using web services and finally the batch jobs sends an email notification to a configurable distribution list to let the people know the reports are ready. Java, Linux Crontab, Shell Script, SMTP, JDBC, TFP, SharePoint, Web Services, JAX-B, JAX-WS and Apache POI.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: To develop new web pages using Apache Tapestry framework, HTML, CSS, Java, Servlets, I created several web pages for this project which was based on Model View Controller design pattern, and some other such as DAO and Singleton. Worked on front and backend using JDBC to establish DB connectivity, SQL to extract information from the DB and show it on the view, using of controllers to administrate the business rules and high amount of data processing.
